confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use Cairo-specific aggregated price excerpts from web search results. Sources mix 2026, older and undated figures, and none is an official survey. USD values assume about 50-52 EGP per USD, the range implied by the sources (roughly 48-53), so they move with the pound. Meal anchors are best supported, partly by a New Cairo district figure. Coffee is supported by several Cairo averages. Beer uses pub and budget-site figures with a small restaurant uplift and excludes hotel bars. Cocktail is supported by two sources and sits about 2.5x beer. Wine is derived from beer (about 1.8x) because no reliable restaurant wine-by-the-glass average was found. The mid-range meal may be low if bills add a 12% service charge and 14% VAT. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation searches were run and no live booking pages or listings were inspected. The fx observation is the latest RBA figure found (18 Nov 2026); a 19 Nov 2026 figure was not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution was used. Food and drink anchors rely on Cairo-specific aggregated price evidence; accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Cairo's hostel and hotel tiers. Region is Africa because Cairo is in Northern Africa.
